title: Super Mario Advance 4 - Super Mario Bros. 3 (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)

fields.name: sma4_magic
fields.evidence: FUN_0803b0dc 8-byte loop called in FUN_0803bc5c; bytes verbatim in both populated saves both copies

fields.name: sma4_header_u32_at_0x0c
fields.evidence: Constant 0x4E20 in all copies; semantics unknown (matches neither block nor media size)

fields.name: sma4_header_u32_at_0x10
fields.evidence: Constant 3 across captures; version/count semantics unproven. Empirically verified via headless mGBA boundary fuzzing (save rejection boundary: unsigned-range [0, 40960]).

fields.name: sma4_header_bytes_0x18
fields.evidence: Two 0xFF sentinels; covered by checksum so probe mutation at 0x1A must fail integrity

fields.name: sma4_record_array
fields.evidence: Layout: stride-0x15 alignment from 0x78 hits 72/72 at byte+8; semantics (per-level/world progress) UNKNOWN — no progressed capture

fields.name: sma4_tail_u16_group_0x728
fields.evidence: Only non-zero u16 group in block tail (block offsets 0x728-0x72F); no diff capture

fields.name: sma4_tail_sentinels
fields.evidence: Isolated 0xFF bytes; last non-zero byte at block offset 0x7D2, rest to 0xFFF zero

fields.name: m3p0_magic
fields.evidence: 12 head positions verbatim in populated saves

fields.name: m3p0_checksum
fields.evidence: Python verified all 6 blocks both saves; halves differ only in these 2 bytes

fields.name: m3p0_slot_index
fields.evidence: Populated M3P0 blocks differ only at +0x04,+0x08,+0x808; sector selection uses separate RAM counter in FUN_0803c308/FUN_0803d440

fields.name: m3p0_payload_half
fields.evidence: Layout proven by FUN_0803c91c/FUN_0803c6b0 and .sav texture; all field semantics UNKNOWN (no progressed diff)

fields.name: m3p0_second_half
fields.evidence: Per-block half diff = exactly 2 bytes in both saves

fields.name: s4cp_magic
fields.evidence: FUN_0803b124 4-byte loop; bytes verbatim in saves

fields.name: s4cp_checksum
fields.evidence: Python verified all completed copies; 2 mid-write copies match after erased-tail (0xFF->0x00) correction

fields.name: s4cp_payload
fields.evidence: Emptiness verified in .sav; semantics unknown — may be default state or assembled outside trace
